items.exampleEn: The dog sat compliantly as soon as it was told to.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗一被叫坐下，就乖乖地坐好。

items.exampleEn: Fast rides exhilarate some people and frighten others.
items.exampleZh: 刺激的遊樂設施讓有些人興奮不已，卻讓另一些人害怕。

items.exampleEn: The ladder stood insecurely on the wet floor.
items.exampleZh: 梯子不穩地立在濕滑的地板上。
items.glossZh: 不穩固地；缺乏安全感地

items.exampleEn: The article insensitively joked about people who had lost their jobs.
items.exampleZh: 那篇文章很不厚道地拿失業的人開玩笑。

items.exampleEn: The trainee chef behaved insubordinately toward the head chef and was moved to washing dishes.
items.exampleZh: 那名實習廚師對主廚態度不服從，被調去洗碗。

items.exampleEn: He shook his head irately when the shop refused his card.
items.exampleZh: 店家拒收他的卡時，他氣憤地搖頭。

items.exampleEn: Some of the dancers moved rather raunchily for a family TV show.
items.exampleZh: 以闔家觀賞的電視節目來說，有些舞者的動作太露骨了。

items.sentenceEn: The workers followed the new safety rules compliantly.
items.sentenceZh: 工人們順從地遵守新的安全規定。

items.audioEn: The shelf had been fixed insecurely, and it fell as soon as I put my books on it.
items.audioZh: 那個架子沒裝牢，我一放書上去就掉下來了。
options: It was much too small for the books.
It was painted a strange color.

items.sentenceEn: Watching the sunrise from the mountain top exhilarated all of us.
items.sentenceZh: 在山頂看日出，讓我們每個人都興奮不已。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't speak insensitively about other people's problems.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要毫不體貼地談論別人的難處。

items.stemEn: The picture was hung ____, and it crashed to the floor that night.
items.stemZh: 那幅畫掛得不牢，當晚就砸到地上了。

items.stemEn: The volunteer ____ ignored the organizer's instructions and opened the gates an hour early.
items.stemZh: 那名志工不服從主辦人的指示，提早一小時就把大門打開。

items.passageEn: Working at a hotel front desk can be stressful. Last Friday, a guest complained irately that his room key did not work. A young colleague answered insensitively, saying it was probably the guest's own fault, which made things worse. When the manager told him to apologize, he responded insubordinately and walked away. Lin, the shift leader, kept her poise. She fixed the key, offered a free breakfast and asked the guest to sign a short form, which he did compliantly. Later, a sign that had been fixed insecurely to the wall fell down in the lobby, and at the bar a singer was dressed rather raunchily, and a few older guests complained to Lin. Still, the challenge of solving one problem after another exhilarated Lin.
items.passageZh: 在飯店櫃台工作可能壓力很大。上星期五，一位客人氣沖沖地抱怨房卡不能用。一位年輕同事很不體貼地回答說，大概是客人自己的錯，結果讓情況更糟。經理叫他道歉時，他不服從地頂了回去，然後走開。值班主管 Lin 保持鎮定。她修好房卡，送客人一份免費早餐，再請客人簽一張簡短的表格，客人也照做了。後來，大廳裡一塊沒釘牢的告示牌從牆上掉了下來；酒吧的駐唱歌手穿得有點露骨，幾位年長的客人向 Lin 抱怨。儘管如此，一個接一個解決問題的挑戰，還是讓 Lin 感到興奮。

questions.questionZh: 那位年輕同事被要求道歉時怎麼做？
Lin 怎麼解決客人房卡的問題？
options: 修好房卡，再送客人免費早餐

items.promptZh: 那位客人氣沖沖地把湯推回給服務生。
referenceEn: The customer irately pushed the soup back to the waiter.
The guest pushed the soup back to the waiter irately.
rubricZh: 「氣沖沖地」用副詞 irately，位置例如動詞前（irately pushed）、句尾（…to the waiter irately）等
「推回給」可寫，例如 pushed…back to、sent…back to 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 pushed）

items.promptZh: 觀眾的歡呼聲讓所有球員都振奮起來。
referenceEn: The crowd's cheers exhilarated all the players.
All the players were exhilarated by the cheering of the crowd.
rubricZh: 「使振奮」用 exhilarate（例如 exhilarated the players、were exhilarated by… 等）
「歡呼聲」可寫，例如 cheers、cheering 等
時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確

A young colleague answered insensitively, saying it was probably the guest's own fault, which made things worse. When the manager told him to apologize, he responded insubordinately and walked away. Lin, the shift leader, kept her poise. She fixed the key, offered a free breakfast and asked the guest to sign a short form, which he did compliantly.
